items.stem:
Read the passage below, based on the autobiographical sketch 'The Portrait of a Lady', and answer.

"Every morning the old woman woke the boy, bathed him and slipped his wooden slate into a cloth bag. They walked to the temple together, she murmuring prayers, he chanting his alphabet. At the gate she settled down with her book of scriptures while the priest taught the children. On the way back she would break stale chapatis for the dogs that followed them, barking and fighting for the pieces."

items.stem:
Read the survey report and answer the questions that follow.

A survey on water use was carried out in Delhi in 2026. 400 families were asked which activity uses most of their daily water. The results were: bathing – 13%; washing clothes – 29%; cooking and drinking – 16%; cleaning the house – 20%; gardening – 22%. The organisers said the findings would help them plan better, and they encouraged people to think about how they conserve and use their time and resources.

(i) How many families chose "washing clothes"?  (a) 29  (b) 116  (c) 1160  (d) 88
(ii) By how many percentage points does "washing clothes" differ from "gardening"?  (a) 12  (b) 51  (c) 7  (d) 4
(iii) Which of these statements is supported by the survey?  (a) "bathing" was chosen by more families than "washing clothes".  (b) Every response was chosen by the same number of families.  (c) The survey was carried out in Lucknow.  (d) "washing clothes" was chosen by more families than "gardening".
(iv) Suggest one reason why "bathing" may have been chosen by so few families.
(v) Write one suggestion the organisers could make, based on the survey on water use.
items.answer: (i) (b) 116 (ii) (c) 7 (iii) (d) "washing clothes" was chosen by more families than "gardening". (iv) Any sensible reason linked to the context (cost, habit, lack of access, awareness, time) – 1 mark. (v) Any practical suggestion that follows from the figures – 1 mark.
items.markingKey: (i) (b) 116 (ii) (c) 7 (iii) (d) "washing clothes" was chosen by more families than "gardening". (iv) Any sensible reason linked to the context (cost, habit, lack of access, awareness, time) – 1 mark. (v) Any practical suggestion that follows from the figures – 1 mark. (1 mark each.)

items.stem:
Read the passage below, based on the autobiographical sketch 'The Portrait of a Lady', and answer.

"Every morning the old woman woke the boy, bathed him and slipped his wooden slate into a cloth bag. They walked to the temple together, she murmuring prayers, he chanting his alphabet. At the gate she settled down with her book of scriptures while the priest taught the children. On the way back she would break stale chapatis for the dogs that followed them, barking and fighting for the pieces."

Answer the following:
(i) Where did the boy and the old woman walk every morning?  (a) To the river  (b) To the market  (c) To the temple school  (d) To the railway station
(ii) What did the old woman do while the children were taught?  (a) She taught the alphabet  (b) She went home  (c) She cooked lunch  (d) She read her book of scriptures at the temple
(iii) Whom did the old woman feed on the way back?  (a) The beggars  (b) The village dogs  (c) The cows  (d) The sparrows
(iv) Which phase of the narrator's life with his grandmother does this passage show?
items.answer: (i) (c) To the temple school (ii) (d) She read her book of scriptures at the temple (iii) (b) The village dogs (iv) The village phase, when they were close friends.
items.markingKey: (i) (c) To the temple school (ii) (d) She read her book of scriptures at the temple (iii) (b) The village dogs (iv) The village phase, when they were close friends. (1 mark each, 4 marks.)

Rank the top three responses, starting with the most common.
